objective: Wire seams S1 (API<->JobStore) and S2 (Worker<->PdfExportService) by running the full import chain end-to-end: verify that app/api.py handlers can import and call JobStore from app/services/jobstore.py, and that the worker thread can import and call PdfExportService from app/services/pdf_export.py; fix any seam defects in T01/T02/T03 code

concepts: import chain: api -> jobstore -> pdf_export -> i18n -> pdflib_shim
seam S1: API creates/reads jobs via JobStore

inputs: Checkpoint outputs from T01, T02, T03, T04

frozen_contracts.spec: JobStore interface: create(customer_id, report_id, lang) -> job_id (str); get(job_id) -> Job | None where Job = {id, customer_id, report_id, lang, status: pending|running|done|failed, result: bytes|None, error: str|None, created_at: str}. Status transitions: pending->running (worker picks up), running->done (PDF generated), running->failed (exception). No other transitions allowed.

PdfExportService interface: export_pdf(customer_id: str, report_id: str, lang: str) -> bytes. Fetches report data via app/queries.report_with_rows (never reads _REPORTS directly). Uses pdflib_shim to render one page per report. Returns raw PDF bytes. Raises PdfExportError on failure. lang must be 'en' or 'de'; unknown lang raises ValueError.

POST /reports/{id}/export-pdf: body {lang: str (optional, default 'en')} -> 202 {job_id: str}. 404 if report_id unknown. 400 if lang not in {en, de}. GET /jobs/{id} -> 200 {job_id, status, result_available: bool, error: str|None}. 404 if job unknown. GET /jobs/{id}/download -> 200 (application/pdf bytes) if done, 409 if not done, 404 if unknown.
